summary: "Open DFM JSON" now shows the method read only in Arcode.
details: The method is loaded from the server the same way the DFM page loads it, so the window no longer opens the method file over the shared drive.
A "Read only" chip marks the tab, and Save, Ctrl+S and ArcBot edits are turned off there; change the method in its DFM page.
Other JSON files you open in Arcode keep their normal Save.
